capabilities: (AI) searches notes semantically and by keyword
compiles topics into new notes with citations
reformats and edits selected text via diff approval
processes daily notes into topic notes
disambiguation: Not a simple chat interface; it is an autonomous agent that performs multi-step tasks across multiple notes.
extras: Free and open source (MIT licensed). No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry. Requires specific GPU VRAM for optimal performance.
intentEvidence: A fully local, agentic AI assistant for Obsidian, powered by Ollama.
motivation: It is part of the Companion suite of local-first Obsidian plugins by Tony Peonio for students and researchers.
problem: Users struggle with manually searching large vaults, compiling complex topics, or trusting AI edits without oversight.
summary: A local AI agent powered by Ollama that searches, compiles, and edits notes within the vault, ensuring all changes are diff-approved.
